settings.skillHint: Filter skills by source path (all selected by default; uncheck to exclude a path). Paths are reported by the kernel, read-only; toggles render by kernel capability; changes take effect next session.
settings.skillNextSession: Changes take effect on next session
settings.skillToggleEnable: Enable / disable (writes +/- entries to settings.json, takes effect next session)
settings.skillToggleForce: Pin to context: when pinned, the skill enters the system prompt and the model can invoke it; when unpinned, it can only be triggered manually via /skill
